# Configuration reference

dash reads its settings from four layers; each overrides the one before it, setting by setting:
the built-in defaults, the settings saved from the UI, the config file and the environment. The
file is `DASH_CONFIG`, or `config.yaml` in the data directory. The JSON Schema of the file is
`dash config schema`; `dash config validate` checks a file and the environment without starting dash.

Every setting has a variable: `DASH_` plus its path in UPPER_SNAKE case. Lists and objects are JSON
(`DASH_PLUGINS_HARDWARE_HOSTS='[{"nodename":"pve"}]'`). Append `_FILE` to read the value from a file
(`DASH_PLUGINS_PROXMOX_TOKEN_SECRET_FILE=/run/secrets/pve`); set only one of the two forms.

A secret takes a literal, `env:NAME` or `file:/path`. In this release every change to a setting other
than a secret needs a restart, whatever the "restart-only" mark says: the mark is for the settings
that stay restart-only once the plugin framework applies the rest live. A rotated secret file
applies live.

## `server`

How dash listens and what it calls itself.

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `server.publicURL` | `DASH_SERVER_PUBLIC_URL` | string | - | The URL people open, with scheme and host (https://dash.example.com). Required; the only Origin accepted on writes. In dev and demo mode it defaults to http://localhost:5173. _Restart-only._ |
| `server.listen` | `DASH_SERVER_LISTEN` | string | `127.0.0.1:8080` | Address of the API and the web UI, reached through the identity proxy. Dev mode only accepts a loopback address. _Restart-only._ |
| `server.healthListen` | `DASH_SERVER_HEALTH_LISTEN` | string | `0.0.0.0:8081` | Address of /healthz and /readyz. In dev and demo mode it defaults to 127.0.0.1:8081. _Restart-only._ |
| `server.allowedHosts` | `DASH_SERVER_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | list of strings (JSON) | - | Host names the API answers besides the host of publicURL: names or IP addresses without scheme or port. ["*"] accepts any. A JSON list in the environment. _Restart-only._ |
| `server.readyRequires` | `DASH_SERVER_READY_REQUIRES` | list of strings (JSON) | - | Plugins /readyz waits for: each listed plugin must have finished starting (its first poll or cache sync) before dash reports ready, up to readyTimeout. Empty: /readyz needs only that dash is serving and every plugin's start has returned. Names are plugins.<id> sections, e.g. ["kubernetes"]. A JSON list in the environment. _Restart-only._ |
| `server.readyTimeout` | `DASH_SERVER_READY_TIMEOUT` | duration (e.g. 30s) | `1m` | How long /readyz waits for the readyRequires plugins, counted from startup. After that dash reports ready anyway and logs a warning naming the plugins still starting. _Restart-only._ |
| `server.metrics` | `DASH_SERVER_METRICS` | boolean | - | Serve dash's own Prometheus metrics at /metrics on the health listener. Off by default. The listener is unauthenticated and the metrics name plugins and their states, so keep it cluster-internal. _Restart-only._ |

## `server.limits`

What one client, and all clients together, may hold open or send.

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `server.limits.streamsPerUser` | `DASH_SERVER_LIMITS_STREAMS_PER_USER` | integer | `16` | Open /api/v1/stream connections one user may hold; more get 429. _Restart-only._ |
| `server.limits.streams` | `DASH_SERVER_LIMITS_STREAMS` | integer | `256` | Open /api/v1/stream connections in all; more get 503. _Restart-only._ |
| `server.limits.tailsPerUser` | `DASH_SERVER_LIMITS_TAILS_PER_USER` | integer | `4` | Open /api/logs/tail connections one user may hold; more get 429. _Restart-only._ |
| `server.limits.tails` | `DASH_SERVER_LIMITS_TAILS` | integer | `32` | Open /api/logs/tail connections in all; more get 503. _Restart-only._ |
| `server.limits.tailMaxDuration` | `DASH_SERVER_LIMITS_TAIL_MAX_DURATION` | duration (e.g. 30s) | `30m` | A log tail ends after this long and the browser reconnects. _Restart-only._ |
| `server.limits.sseWriteTimeout` | `DASH_SERVER_LIMITS_SSE_WRITE_TIMEOUT` | duration (e.g. 30s) | `10s` | A stalled stream write fails after this long. _Restart-only._ |
| `server.limits.bodyReadTimeout` | `DASH_SERVER_LIMITS_BODY_READ_TIMEOUT` | duration (e.g. 30s) | `10s` | A request body must arrive within this long. _Restart-only._ |
| `server.limits.maxHeaderBytes` | `DASH_SERVER_LIMITS_MAX_HEADER_BYTES` | integer | `65536` | Largest request header block the API listener accepts, in bytes. _Restart-only._ |

## `settings`

The settings store behind the settings page.

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `settings.ui` | `DASH_SETTINGS_UI` | string | `editable` | Whether the settings page may save values: editable, or readonly (fully managed, GitOps). A data directory that is missing or not writable is read-only either way. _Restart-only._ |

## Top level

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dataDir` | `DASH_DATA_DIR` | string | `/data` | Where dash keeps its state (ui-settings.yaml, audit.jsonl) and looks for config.yaml. Demo mode uses none. _Restart-only._ |

## `ui`

What the web UI is told by the server.

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ui.iconBaseURL` | `DASH_UI_ICON_BASE_URL` | string | - | Where icon names resolve: an icon called proxmox is requested from <iconBaseURL>/proxmox.png, and an icon URL is only used when it lies under this URL. An http(s) URL with a host, without query or fragment, e.g. https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons/png. Empty requests no icon from any third party: an icon name shows a letter tile. _Restart-only._ |

## `plugins.prometheus`

VictoriaMetrics or Prometheus: the series behind charts, KPIs and host metrics.

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `plugins.prometheus.type` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_TYPE` | string | - | The plugin type. dash runs one instance per type, so this is empty or the section name. |
| `plugins.prometheus.enabled` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_ENABLED` | boolean | - | false turns the plugin off (a restart applies it): its topics are removed, and the web UI drops its rail entry, palette entries, overview tiles and panels and shows a switched-off page at its address. The Kubernetes connection is required whichever plugins are off. Unset leaves it on: a plugin without its settings reports itself unavailable (not configured), and the web UI hides its pages. |
| `plugins.prometheus.url` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_URL` | string | - | Base URL of the service, e.g. http://host:9090. Empty turns the source off: dash makes no request and its panels show "source not configured". |
| `plugins.prometheus.timeout` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_TIMEOUT` | duration (e.g. 30s) | `5s` | How long one query may take before dash gives up on it. |
| `plugins.prometheus.headers` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_HEADERS` | object (JSON) | - | Extra headers sent with every request, as {name: value}. Plain configuration, not secrets: put credentials in auth. Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie and Host cannot be set. A JSON object in the environment. |

## `plugins.prometheus.auth.basic`

HTTP Basic authentication. Not together with bearerToken.

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `plugins.prometheus.auth.basic.username` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_AUTH_BASIC_USERNAME` | string | - | User name. |
| `plugins.prometheus.auth.basic.password` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_AUTH_BASIC_PASSWORD` | string | - | Password: a literal, env:NAME or file:/path. Set together with username. _Secret._ |

## `plugins.prometheus.auth`

How dash authenticates to the service. Neither basic nor bearerToken sends no credentials.

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `plugins.prometheus.auth.bearerToken` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_AUTH_BEARER_TOKEN` | string | - | Bearer token sent as Authorization: Bearer: a literal, env:NAME or file:/path. Not together with basic. _Secret._ |

## `plugins.prometheus.tls`

How dash verifies the service's certificate.

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `plugins.prometheus.tls.caFile` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_TLS_CA_FILE` | string | - | Path of a PEM file with the certificate authority that signed the service's certificate, added to the system roots. Empty uses the system roots only. |
| `plugins.prometheus.tls.insecureSkipVerify` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_TLS_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY` | boolean | - | Skip verifying the service's certificate and host name. Anyone on the network path can then impersonate the service: prefer caFile. |

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `plugins.kubernetes.conventions.protectedLabel` | `DASH_PLUGINS_KUBERNETES_CONVENTIONS_PROTECTED_LABEL` | string | - | Namespace label (value "true") that makes a restart ask you to type the namespace name. Empty protects no namespace. |
| `plugins.kubernetes.conventions.tenantLabel` | `DASH_PLUGINS_KUBERNETES_CONVENTIONS_TENANT_LABEL` | string | - | Namespace label that puts the namespace under Tenants; its value is the tenant. Empty turns the grouping off. |
| `plugins.kubernetes.conventions.appsFluxPrefix` | `DASH_PLUGINS_KUBERNETES_CONVENTIONS_APPS_FLUX_PREFIX` | string | - | Namespaces applied by a Flux Kustomization whose name starts with this prefix are listed under Apps. Empty turns the grouping off. |

## `plugins.flux`

Flux: how dash reads Flux objects.

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `plugins.flux.type` | `DASH_PLUGINS_FLUX_TYPE` | string | - | The plugin type. dash runs one instance per type, so this is empty or the section name. |
| `plugins.flux.enabled` | `DASH_PLUGINS_FLUX_ENABLED` | boolean | - | false turns the plugin off (a restart applies it): its topics are removed, and the web UI drops its rail entry, palette entries, overview tiles and panels and shows a switched-off page at its address. The Kubernetes connection is required whichever plugins are off. Unset leaves it on: a plugin without its settings reports itself unavailable (not configured), and the web UI hides its pages. |
| `plugins.flux.suspendReasonAnnotation` | `DASH_PLUGINS_FLUX_SUSPEND_REASON_ANNOTATION` | string | - | Flux object annotation whose value is shown as the reason the object is suspended. Empty hides the reason. |

## Process variables

These are not settings; the config file cannot set them.

| Variable | What |
|---|---|
| `DASH_CONFIG` | Path of the config file. It must exist. Without it dash reads `config.yaml` in the data directory when there is one. |
| `DASH_DEV` | `true` signs every request in as `dev` without authentication and uses the development defaults; it only starts on a loopback `server.listen`. |
| `DASH_DEMO` | `true` serves fake data and contacts nothing; it opens no data directory. |
| `DASH_SECRET_KEY`, `DASH_SECRET_KEY_FILE` | The key that encrypts secrets saved from the UI. Without one they can only be set through `env:` and `file:` references. |
| `DASH_SECRET_KEY_PREVIOUS`, `DASH_SECRET_KEY_PREVIOUS_FILE` | The key being rotated out. |
| `KUBECONFIG` | Fills `plugins.kubernetes.kubeconfig` (another tool's variable: no `_FILE` form). The generated name wins over it. |

The names dash read before the config file (`DASH_PUBLIC_URL`, `DASH_VM_URL` and the like) were removed in
0.5.0; dash refuses to start and names the replacement. See "Removed variable names" in the README.
